resources.string: NEXVARY MR · Recovery Agent
Local metadata assessment · Android 8+ · No deleted-file recovery or device modification

Important: installing this APK, running Android, and starting Shizuku write to the phone. Those writes can reduce the chance of recovering deleted data. If deleted data matters, stop using the phone and consult a recovery specialist before installation. Reads can also update system/provider records. This tool does not recover deleted or encrypted private app data.
I own this device or have the owner’s explicit permission. I understand the write impact and consent only to device metadata and a file I explicitly choose.
Optional Shizuku status: %1$s
1 · Read public device and storage metadata
2 · Request optional Shizuku permission
3 · Run fixed shell metadata probes
Choose one local file and calculate SHA-256

Only Android system local-document providers are accepted. No directory scan, private app data, partition image, or file content enters the report. Maximum file size: 16 GiB; hashing stops after five minutes or when the app leaves the foreground.
Cancel active operation
Export metadata JSON for NEXVARY MR

Export creates a new document in a location you choose. The report contains device metadata and the chosen file’s name, size and hash. Review before sharing. It is not proof of ownership, firmware authenticity, or successful recovery.
No metadata has been collected. Confirm the scope, then start a read.
Consent revoked; volatile collected metadata cleared.
Shizuku disconnected; privileged results cleared and the active probe canceled.
Shizuku permission is unavailable or revoked; privileged results cleared.
Reading fixed shell metadata…
Fixed metadata probes completed. Review the report; unavailable probes do not establish device health.
The optional helper could not connect within five seconds. Check Shizuku, permission and shell mode.
Reading public Android metadata…
Public device metadata read. Only storage volumes visible through the Android public API are listed.
Root mode is unsupported and refused. No privileged probe was started. Use Shizuku started with ADB as UID 2000.

Install and start the official Shizuku app yourself if needed. Non-root Android 11+ supports wireless debugging; earlier supported versions need a computer to start Shizuku. Restart Shizuku after reboot. This agent never installs or starts it automatically.
Permission was denied. Review this agent in Shizuku’s authorized-app list; no repeated permission request was sent.
A live, explicitly authorized Shizuku shell UID 2000 is required. Root and unknown UIDs are refused.
Connecting the optional shell metadata helper…
Choose a local file using Android’s system storage, downloads or media document provider. Other providers and network locations are refused.
Calculating the selected local file’s SHA-256 without copying its contents into the report…
SHA-256 calculated for the selected file. A hash does not prove authenticity or recoverability.
Report is not ready or exceeds its size limits. Collect public metadata and review the scope first.
Writing the explicitly selected report document…
Metadata JSON exported. Transfer that file yourself and import it in NEXVARY MR.
The metadata operation failed, was denied, changed during reading, or exceeded a size limit. No device repair or recovery operation was performed.
Operation canceled.
Operation timed out and was canceled. Try a smaller local file or review the connection.
Active work canceled because the app left the foreground. No background scan continues.
